objectives.text: Travel to __guild_ in the ____guild_ and look into the rumors of the vanished master armorer

outcomes.text: You reached __guild_, where the trail of the missing armorer begins.
Six months passed, and the local guild was left to deal with it alone.

objectives.text: Meet the guild's contact, _contact_, at the Fighters Guild hall in __guild_
Track the finely armored soldiers to their lord's stronghold, using the witnesses' accounts or the trackers'
Win _armorer_'s freedom from _lord_ at __fort_: the Brotherhood's contract, a million gold, or the sword
Recover the Dark Brotherhood's contract. Meet _dbContact_ at _dbTavern_ in __dbTavern_.
Take _armorer_ back to _contact_ in __guild_ and help him choose a new home

outcomes.text: You cut through _lord_'s garrison until they gave _armorer_ up, and he has a new forge.
You paid _lord_ a million gold for _armorer_'s freedom, and he has a new forge.
The Brotherhood's own contract broke _lord_'s hold, and _armorer_ has a new forge.
_armorer_ is free, and has settled at a new forge.
_lord_'s garrison held, and _armorer_ still works their forge.

objectives.text: Keep watch. The Dark Brotherhood will send word of its price.
Pay _dbContact_ 100,000 gold at _dbFront_ in __dbFront_ within three weeks
Carry 200,000 gold for when the Brotherhood's enforcers find you
Carry 300,000 gold. The Brotherhood will offer one last chance to pay.

outcomes.text: You paid the Brotherhood's price, and its enforcers were called off.
The Brotherhood's enforcers took 200,000 gold, and the debt is settled.
You paid 300,000 gold at the last chance, and the Brotherhood let you live.
The Brotherhood stopped asking for gold.

objectives.text: Gather two wood bundles. Chop them or come by them however you like.
Bring the two bundles to _questgiver_ at __questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ within =deadline_ days

outcomes.text: _questgiver_ has firewood enough for the hearth.
The firewood never came, and _questgiver_'s hearth went cold.

objectives.text: Gather four wood bundles. Chop them or come by them however you like.
Bring the four bundles to _questgiver_ at __questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ within =deadline_ days

outcomes.text: _questgiver_'s woodpile is stocked, four bundles deep.
The firewood never came, and _questgiver_ found someone else.

objectives.text: Gather six wood bundles for the witch burning. Chop them or come by them however you like.
Bring the six bundles to _questgiver_ at __questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ within =deadline_ days

outcomes.text: You brought six bundles for the pyre, and the witch burning goes ahead.
The wood never came, and the pyre stood unbuilt on the day.

objectives.text: Gather eight wood bundles for the execution scaffold. Chop them or come by them however you like.
Bring the eight bundles to _questgiver_ at __questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ within =deadline_ days

outcomes.text: You brought eight bundles for the scaffold, and the hanging goes ahead on time.
The timber never came, and the scaffold went unbuilt.
